name: agentarmy-jwt-introspect
description: JWT introspection sidecar — function-tier image. Verifies the user JWT forwarded across the FE → MC → BE chain per ARC-ADR-002. Provides a /introspect endpoint any spoke can call to convert a Bearer token into a verified claims object (or 401). Centralizes JWKS caching + leeway handling + algorithm allowlisting so every spoke isn't re-implementing JWT verify.

shims.note: PyJWT[crypto] for RS256/ES256 + JWKS; httpx for JWKS reachability probe. Constant-time signature verify is provided by the underlying cryptography library. Algorithm allowlist hard-coded at startup refuses HS* (symmetric) and `none` even if env tries to inject them.

baked.purpose: FastAPI app: POST /introspect (token in, claims out or 401), GET /livez + /readyz + /healthz. JWKS cached with TTL under an asyncio.Lock so concurrent first-callers see one fetch. Algorithm allowlist enforced at startup (RS256/ES256 only).

5-check doctor: mints its own RSA keypair + JWKS + JWTs, serves the JWKS on host:8085, then verifies readiness, valid-returns-claims, tampered→401, expired→401, and leeway-honored (restart with leeway=60, 30s-stale JWT → 200).

doctor.description: Mints an RSA keypair + JWKS + 4 test tokens locally; /healthz reports jwks_reachable=true; valid token returns active:true + the expected sub claim; tampered token (mutated signature byte) returns 401; 60s-expired token (leeway=0) returns 401; 30s-expired token after restart with leeway=60 returns 200. Verified locally: 5/5 PASS.

deploy.notes: Sidecar to any spoke that needs to verify a forwarded JWT. Internal-only ingress; the spoke calls 127.0.0.1:8084 inside the same network namespace.

contract.note: Realizes the verify-once-in-each-spoke half of ARC-ADR-002 (JWT-forwarding auth contract). No new external contract — the OAuth/OIDC issuer's JWKS is the only upstream. Revocation-list integration is the next roadmap step.
